in_marathi.name: Andal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Andal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Andal is the name of a renowned Tamil poetess and saint. She is believed to have lived in the 9th or 10th century in Tamil Nadu, India. Andal is known for her love and devotion towards Lord Vishnu and is considered an embodiment of his divine grace. Her poems, known as 'nachchiyar thirumizhal', are filled with love, devotion, and yearning for the divine.
